title: Long-term Extension Study to Assess Adverse Events and Tolerability of Oral Atogepant Tablets in Pediatric Participants (6 to 17 Years of Age) With Migraine
official: A Multicenter, Open-label, Extension Study to Evaluate the Long-term Safety and Tolerability of Atogepant in Pediatric Subjects 6 to 17 years of age with Migraine
summary: Main objective: To evaluate the long-term safety and tolerability of atogepant treatment for the prevention of migraine in pediatric participants 6 to 17 years of age.
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Participants must be between 6 and 17 years of age (inclusive), with a history of episodic or chronic migraine.
2. Participant must have completed the lead-in Study M21-201, or the pharmacokinetic (PK) substudy in Study M21-201 or the lead-in Study M23-712.
3. Weight is >= 20 kg (44 lbs) and < 135 kg (298 lbs).
4. A history of migraine with or without aura consistent with a diagnosis according to the International Classification of Headache Disorders, 3rd Edition (ICHD-3; 2018) for at least 6 months.
Exclusion criteria:
1. History of migraine with brainstem aura, hemiplegic migraine, or retinal migraine as defined by ICHD-3 (2018).
2. Have a current diagnosis of new daily persistent headache, trigeminal autonomic cephalgia (e.g., cluster headache), or painful cranial neuropathy as defined by ICHD-3 (2018).
3. Have any clinically significant hematologic, endocrine, pulmonary, renal, hepatic, gastrointestinal, cardiovascular, or neurologic disease.
